name: 77041 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77041 (Houston) has 120 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77041 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77041 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
